title: The full sectionwise abelian-object functor
statement: Let C be a category with a Grothendieck topology J. In any universe at least as large as the object and morphism universes of C, there exists a full functor F from abelian sheaves to internal commutative group objects of sheaves of sets. Its underlying functor is exactly sectionwise forgetting. Transport along this functor equality sends the internal multiplication, unit, and inverse to sectionwise addition, zero, and negation.

proof.text: Retain the underlying sheaf of sets. Define internal multiplication, unit and inverse using addition, zero and negation in each section group. Restriction homomorphisms prove naturality; section group laws prove all internal diagrams. Define the map functor by underlying sheaf maps and verify identity and composition.

For any internal morphism between two resulting objects, evaluate its unit and multiplication equations on sections. These give map_zero and map_add, so each component defines an additive group homomorphism. Its naturality is the naturality of the underlying sheaf map. These components assemble into an abelian sheaf morphism whose image is the original morphism, proving fullness. The underlying functor equality and all operation formulas are definitional.
